# Firmcraft

> Firmcraft is an advisory practice for mid-market companies bringing
> artificial intelligence into finance and operations. The firm advises on
> artificial intelligence and technology strategy, implements what the strategy
> requires, and manages the result on an ongoing basis. Firmcraft is led by an
> advisor with more than two decades in enterprise software and digital
> transformation, spanning business process design, solution architecture, and
> implementation for operations-heavy and asset-intensive organizations.

Firmcraft works with mid-market organizations where the owner, chief executive,
or finance and operations leadership drives the technology agenda. The practice
is independent: it does not resell software and does not receive vendor margin.

## Practice
- [Advisory](https://firmcraft.ai/advisory): advisory, managed AI services, and infrastructure
- [How We Work](https://firmcraft.ai/how-we-work): assessment, implementation, and ongoing support
- [Data Sovereignty](https://firmcraft.ai/sovereignty): how client data is handled and where systems run
- [For Small Business](https://firmcraft.ai/for-small-business): managed artificial intelligence capability for smaller organizations
